findings: Exclusive overall and each-step artifacts prevent automatic retries or adopting a pre-existing matrix.
History continuation remains externally owned: no process or unit signal is sent while waiting.
Only originalmatrix off->audit->on->audit->compare->aggregate runs; no business/lifecycle/next-candidate entry.
Comparison/aggregate rc3 accepted only with exact bound validNO_GO decision and complete contracts; parent rc0 means controller completed, not performancePASS.
A child interruption signals only its unreaped direct PID withSIGINT thenSIGTERM; no killpg/SIGKILL or unrelatedunit action. Unknown cleanup stops subsequent steps and requires inspection.
Timeouts retain fixed21600s inner matrix bound plus1800s outer cleanup allowance; no sample/time retry branch.
limits: Static review only; did not import/execute controller, run tests/model, or inspect speed values.
If a child fails to terminate after grace, cleanup remainsUNKNOWN and cannot be treated as clean delivery.
